title: Insha ya Masimulizi (Theme 9: Sokoni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans in three boxes, writes one idea per sentence in one tense with Kiswahili words, then reads it back and corrects it.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a sentence with a capital and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a word bank of theme words and kwanza, kisha, mwishowe
a model insha on the board
steps: Plan: who, where, what happened, end.
contexts: a story to read to a parent

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes the first two sentences of the insha and reads them aloud.

misconceptions.repair: Kisa kina mwanzo, kati na mwisho.
Kichwa kinasema insha inahusu nini: Safari Yangu ya Sokoni.

listen_for: Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni.
misconceptions.repair: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.

listen_for: Tulifika sokoni mapema. Mama ananunua ndizi.
misconceptions.repair: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hilo ni la lugha gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa Kiswahili: Tulinunua sukumawiki na vitunguu.

checks.question: Kichwa kifaacho insha kuhusu sokoni ni?
Sahihisha: Tulifika sokoni mapema. Mama ananunua ndizi.
checks.answer: Tulifika sokoni mapema. Mama alinunua ndizi.
